description: This file contains a Python module defining the ReferenceQuantizedModule class and associated functions for handling weight quantization, dequantization, and related operations used in quantized neural network implementations within the PyTorch framework.

classes.name: ReferenceQuantizedModule
classes.description: A PyTorch module for managing quantization parameters and fake quantization/dequantization of weights for reference implementation purposes.

methods.name: _init_weight_qparams(self, weight_qparams, device)
methods.description: Initializes quantization parameters for the weight tensor, setting buffers for scale, zero_point, and axis based on provided weight_qparams.

methods.name: get_weight(self)
methods.description: Returns a fake quantized version of the weight for simulation purposes by quantizing and then dequantizing the weight tensor.

methods.name: get_quantized_weight(self)
methods.description: Returns the quantized weight tensor based on stored quantization parameters.

methods.name: _save_to_state_dict(self, destination, prefix, keep_vars)
methods.description: Saves quantization parameters to the state dictionary for checkpointing or model serialization.

methods.name: _load_from_state_dict( self, state_dict, prefix, local_metadata, strict, missing_keys, unexpected_keys, error_msgs, )
methods.description: Loads quantization parameters from the state dictionary during model loading.
